retrievalProfile.description: A tight, soft-focus male portrait in profile featuring custom 70s-style flame-tipped lettering in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, three-quarter profile portrait of a man with dark hair and a prominent mustache, characterized by soft lighting and a shallow depth of field. The composition is anchored by the subject's face on the left, with stylized, green-outlined flame typography positioned in the negative space of the dark hair on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed off-camera to the left
Typography nested within the dark texture of the hair
Contrast between warm skin tones and cool green graphic accents
Polka dot pattern at the bottom edge providing a geometric counterpoint
coreInvariants: Flame-like extensions on the horizontal strokes of the display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale headshot occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eye, following the bridge of the nose down to the mustache, then sweeping up to the bright green text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured area of the hair serves as a backdrop for the primary typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the hair and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Kelly green used for the primary text outline.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photograph contrasted with high saturation in the graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy 70s tones with one bright pop color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, slanted sans-serif with rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal strokes on the right side of characters extend into three-pronged flame wisps
Thick white fill with a double outline (inner black, outer green)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'S' feature the most prominent flame extensions
Lower-case style 'i' with a circular tittle integrated into the flame path
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly stylized custom display type paired with a functional, clean sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary 70s weight and roundness as a base for flame modifications.
The flame wisps are too specific for a standard font.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, 1970s-style film photograph of a man's profile with a mustache and dark wavy hair, leaving dark negative space in the upper right. Include a black and white polka dot collar at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom-lettered display text in the upper right with white fill and green outlines, featuring flame-like wisps extending from the right side of the letters.

verificationChecks: Does the text have flame-like extensions?
Is the portrait lighting soft and vintage?
Is the green outline vibrant against the dark hair?
Is the polka dot pattern present at the bottom?

adjustableVariables: Density of the polka dot pattern
mustRedesign: Generic sans-serif fonts without the flame treatment

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality to the flame lettering
Balanced composition between face and text
avoid: Clean vector look for the photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the flame wisps point to the right.
Verify the double outline on the main text.
Check that the portrait maintains a soft, analog feel.
Confirm the text is placed within the hair area.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus 70s portrait + custom flame-tipped display type + high-contrast pattern accent.
